lines.3: Haan Aarav, teen groups. Ab 3 birds ud gaye—screen par kitne birds bache?
lines.4: Pehle 3 the, phir ek uda toh 2 bache. Ab naya step dekho. Ab aage kya karenge? Another flies away: ___ is left.
lines.5: Pehle jitne bache the, unmein se ek aur bird uda do. Ab bache hue birds ko gino. Ab aage kya karenge? Another flies away: ___ is left.
lines.6: “Another flies away” ka matlab hai: ek aur bird ud gaya. Ab jo birds bache, unhe dobara count karna hai. Ab aage kya karenge? Another flies away: ___ is left.
lines.7: Theek hai, Aarav. Ab hum counting ko ek chhote picture-group se milayenge. Taali, taali, taali, taali. Yeh kaun sa number hua?
lines.8: Tumne kaise jaana ki taaliyan chaar hain?
lines.9: Bilkul, tumne har taali ko ek baar ginkar chaar bataya. Main bolti hoon "eight". Ungliyon se 8 dikhao.
lines.10: Haan, ungliyon se dikhana hai. Dono haath saamne karo, phir jitni ungliyan chahiye utni uthao. Main bolti hoon "eight". Ungliyon se 8 dikhao.
lines.11: Aarav, choices hain; tum bas apni choice bolo. Main bolti hoon "eight". Ungliyon se 8 dikhao.
lines.12: Bilkul, tumne 5 aur 3 ungliyan milaakar 8 dikhaya. Tumhare ghar ka number 7 hai. Uske liye kitni taaliyaan bajaoge?
lines.13: Aarav, tumne number ko uske number-name se joda. Ab taali bajane ke liye apne haath taiyaar rakho. Tumhare ghar ka number 7 hai. Uske liye kitni taaliyaan bajao
lines.14: Haan, tumne 7 taaliyan sahi gini. Ab hawa mein numeral 7 ka shape banao—kaise banaoge?
